paper.title_en: Gravitational constant as a conserved charge in black hole thermodynamics
paper.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that couplings multiplying individual terms in a Lagrangian can be promoted to conserved charges by introducing scalar-gauge pairs. The gravitational constant, however, plays a qualitatively different role: $G^{-1}$ appears as an overall normalization of the Einstein-Hilbert sector rather than as the coefficient of a single term. In this paper, we show that the gravitational constant can nevertheless be realized as a conserved charge in a modified four-dimensional Einstein-Hilbert theory. Using two scalar-gauge pairs and the quasi-local off-shell Abbott-Deser-Tekin formalism, we construct the conserved charges associated with the mass, the cosmological constant, and the gravitational constant. The resulting charge assignment yields the extended thermodynamic first law and the Smarr formula in a fully consistent manner. Our result therefore extends the conserved-charge interpretation of couplings to the universal gravitational coupling itself in a concrete four-dimensional Einstein-gravity setting.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接研究黑洞热力学中的守恒荷构造，把引力常数实现为守恒荷，并给出扩展热力学第一定律与Smarr公式，属于黑洞热力学核心议题；理论构造较深，方法明确，与索引主题高度契合。
decision.title_zh: 引力常数作为黑洞热力学中的守恒荷
decision.abstract_zh: 近期工作表明，通过引入标量-规范对，乘在拉格朗日量中单个项上的耦合可以被提升为守恒荷。然而，引力常数扮演着性质不同的角色：$G^{-1}$ 表现为 Einstein-Hilbert 部分的整体归一化，而不是单个项的系数。在本文中，我们表明，在一个修改过的四维 Einstein-Hilbert 理论中，引力常数仍然可以被实现为守恒荷。使用两个标量-规范对以及准局域离壳 Abbott-Deser-Tekin 形式，我们构造了与质量、宇宙学常数和引力常数相关的守恒荷。所得的荷指派以完全一致的方式给出了扩展热力学第一定律和 Smarr 公式。因此，我们的结果在一个具体的四维 Einstein 引力设定中，将耦合的守恒荷解释推广到了普适的引力耦合本身。
